<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|CHA. III.|ACCORDING TO S. LVKE.|143}}</noinclude>{{dropinitial|A|fl={{verse|chapter=3|verse=1}}}}ND {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel vpō Imber Saturday in Aduent. And on the 4 Sunday in Aduent.}}in the fiftenth yere of the empire of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being Gouernour of Ievvrie, and Herod being Tetrarch of Galilee, and Philip his brother Tetrarch of Ituréa and the countrie Trachonîtis, and Lysanias Tetrarch of Abilîna, {{verse|chapter=3|verse=2}}† vnder the high Priests Annas and Caiphas: the vvord of our Lord vvas made vpon Iohn the sonne of Zacharie, in the desert. {{verse|chapter=3|verse=3}}† And {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mt. 3, 1. Mr. 1, 1.''}}* he came into al the countrie of Iordan, preaching the baptisme of {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ Penance prepareth the way to Christ.}}∷ penance vnto remission of sinnes: as it is vvritten in the booke of the sayings of Esay the Prophet: {{verse|chapter=3|verse=4}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Esa. 40, 3.''}}* ''A voice of one crying in the desert: prepare the vvay of our Lord, make straight his pathes''. {{verse|chapter=3|verse=5}}† ''Euery valley shal be filled: and euery mountaine and hil shal be made lovv, and crooked things shal become straight: and rough vvaies, plaine'': {{verse|chapter=3|verse=6}}† ''and al flesh shal see the {{sc|Salvation}} of God''.

{{verse|chapter=3|verse=7}}† He said therfore to the multitudes that vvent forth to be baptized of him, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mt. 3, 7.''}}* Ye vipers broodes, vvho hath shewed you to flee from the vvrath to come? {{verse|chapter=3|verse=8}}† Yeld therfore {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ Fruites of penance be workes satisfactorie.}}∷ fruites vvorthie of penance. and doe ye not begin to say, VVe haue Abraham to our father. For I tel you, that God is able of these stones to raise vp children to Abraham. {{verse|chapter=3|verse=9}}† And novv the axe is put to the roote of the trees. {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ A man without good workes is vnfruitful, and shal be cast into euerlasting fire.}}∷ Euery tree therfore that yeldeth not good fruite, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''`is''}}`shal be' cut dovvne, and cast into fire. {{verse|chapter=3|verse=10}}† And the multitudes asked him, saying, VVhat shal we doe then? {{verse|chapter=3|verse=11}}† And he ansvvering, said vnto them: {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ Almes counseled or enioyned for sinnes and to auoid damnation.}}∷ He that hath tvvo coates, let him giue to him that hath not: and he that hath meate, let him doe likevvise. {{verse|chapter=3|verse=12}}† And the Publicans also came to be baptized, and said to him, Maister, vvhat shal vve doe? {{verse|chapter=3|verse=13}}† But he said to them, Doe nothing more then that vvhich is appointed you. {{verse|chapter=3|verse=14}}† And the souldiars also asked him, saying, VVhat shal vve also doe? And he said to them, Vexe not neither calumniate any man: and be content vvith your stipends.

{{verse|chapter=3|verse=15}}† And {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ Iohn was so holy that many might by errour easily thinke he was Christ.}}∷ the people imagining, and al men thinking in their harts of Iohn, lest perhaps he vvere Christ: {{verse|chapter=3|verse=16}}† Iohn answered, saying vnto al, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mt. 3, 11. Mr. 1, 8.''}}* I in deede baptize you vvith vvater: {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Io. 1, 26. Act. 1, 5. 11, 16. 19, 4.''}}* {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ How say then the Heretikes that the Baptisme of Christ is of no greater vertue then Iohns?}}∷ but there {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''`cometh''}}`shal come' a mightier then I, vvhose latchet of his shoes I am not vvorthie to vnloose, he shal baptize you in the Holy Ghost and fire. {{verse|chapter=3|verse=17}}† vvhose fanne is in his hand, and he vvil purge his floore: and vvil gather the vvheate into his barne, but the chaffe he vvil burne vvith vnquencheable fire. {{verse|chapter=3|verse=18}}† Many other things also exhorting did he euangelize to the people.<noinclude>{{rh|||And}}</noinclude>
